system.description:
Tattoos or scars protective sigils onto a subject who is already under a warding ritual, making that protection lasting. See the Warding Marks benefit.

Ritual. Alignment: Formidable (12) Cunning, 2 hours. Invocation: Hard (15) Knowledge, 3 hours. Unleashing: Hard (15) Will. The subject keeps a ward from another ritual (usually at reduced strength) as long as the marks endure.

Art of Warding — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 106.
system.resonances: Specially crafted inks, pigments and implements (5 gold pieces).

ritual.unleashing: Hard (15) Will. The subject keeps a ward from another ritual (usually at reduced strength) as long as the marks endure.
